program.title: CARL WEATHERS BUILD
program.subtitle: 13-Week Strength + Size — Sandbag, KB, Rings
program.notes: Eating to grow: bodyweight should trend up slowly. Three waves of 3 build weeks plus a lighter week, then test (week 12) and deload (week 13). Schedule: keep a rest day between Sandbag Lower and Pull (e.g. Mon Push, Tue Sandbag, Thu Pull, Sat Legs). Sandbag is maintenance: cleans, shouldering and carries hold at 130lbs all block. Pull-ups restart at bodyweight with a neutral grip on free-rotating rings, and reps only go up when the elbows and shoulders allow. Pain rule: up to 3/10 that is gone by the next morning is OK. Anything more: band-assisted pull-ups, or KB pullovers if those hurt too. Elbow or shoulder pain that lasts more than 2 weeks is worth a physio visit. 24+20 means a mixed pair: switch which hand holds the 24 each set. If you buy a second 24, use 24+24. If top sets stall two weeks in a row, cut accessory sets first.

1.goal: On-ramp. Leave reps in the tank. Pull-ups restart at 3 slow reps; see how elbows and shoulders respond before adding anything.

blocks.note: Shoulders stop just below elbows at the bottom; turn the rings out at the top. If the front of the shoulder complains, cut depth first. Drop to +15lbs if it keeps talking. If dips hurt at any load, do KB Floor Press 10@24+20 instead.
Clean every rep.

The 350 (TREE FITTY): about 70 reps a round, building to 5 rounds (350 reps) in wave 3. Loads stay at 16 all block; progress with a 3s lowering, not weight. Pullover: lie on the floor, knees bent, bell by the horns, ribs down, lower behind your head on a 3-count, pull back with the lats. Lateral raise replaces the upright row. If an elbow goes above 3/10, swap the crush curl for KB Bottoms-Up Hold :20'@16.
Maintenance at 130lbs. Alternate shoulders every rep. Fast and crisp, never a grind.

Maintenance: 130lbs all block, alternating triples and fives. Every rep a clean pickup. If a day feels great you can do one extra triple at 140lbs, but nothing in this block depends on it. Push-ups go in the rest: easy chest volume that doesn't touch the legs or back.
Zercher: size lift for quads and upper back. Bag in the crooks of your elbows, stay tall. Wear sleeves or a towel; if the elbows complain, do SB Bear Hug Squat 8 at the same load instead.
Carries at 130lbs all block; distance goes 40, 50, 60 steps in each wave. Switch shoulders each round.

Neutral grip, rings free to rotate. 3 seconds down on every rep. Add the next rep only if last session stayed at 3/10 or less and the next morning was fine. Pain rule: up to 3/10 in the elbow or shoulder is OK if it is no worse the next morning. Above that: finish the sets as band-assisted pull-ups (@-20lbs); if those hurt too, do KB Pullover 12@16 instead.
Supported row: one hand braced on a box or bench so the lower back rests before leg day. Pause 1s at the top. Floor press keeps chest volume up. 24+20: switch hands each set.
Capped at these reps all block to keep elbow load in check. Squeeze 1s at the top.
Rear delts, side delts, triceps: the shoulder caps and arm size.
Load stays at 130lbs; progress time. Hug it high and tight, upper back working hard.

Clean to the rack once, then run each rung straight through. Box squat: sit, pause 1s. The last dead clean stays racked for the lunges (alternate legs). Swap bells in the rest; 24+20: switch hands each heavy rung.
Hard, snappy swings for hamstrings and glutes to balance all that squatting; snatches keep your EMOM engine and lockout.
RTO = rings turned out at lockout. Chest and arm size work: 1-2 reps short of failure. Overhead extension: elbows in, slow down.
Carry medley with the lighter bag. Smooth distance, not max load.

12.goal: Test the numbers: ring dip top set, pull-up max, KB press 5@24+20. Sandbag day is an easy maintenance session. Everything else is light. Log everything.

blocks.note: TEST: one set of max reps at +30lbs, stopping at the last clean rep. Your cut-block number was 6 reps at +30. Log the real number.
Back-off sets.

TEST: max reps, one set with the 24 in each hand; stop at the last clean rep. Week 11 was 5x5. Mixed pair: switch which hand holds the 24 every set (even set counts keep the sides equal). If you buy a second 24, use 24+24.

The 350 (TREE FITTY): about 70 reps a round, building to 5 rounds (350 reps) in wave 3. Loads stay at 16 all block; progress with a 3s lowering, not weight. Pullover: lie on the floor, knees bent, bell by the horns, ribs down, lower behind your head on a 3-count, pull back with the lats. Lateral raise replaces the upright row. If an elbow goes above 3/10, swap the crush curl for KB Bottoms-Up Hold :20'@16.
Maintenance at 130lbs. Alternate shoulders every rep. Fast and crisp, never a grind.

Maintenance: 130lbs all block, alternating triples and fives. Every rep a clean pickup. If a day feels great you can do one extra triple at 140lbs, but nothing in this block depends on it. Push-ups go in the rest: easy chest volume that doesn't touch the legs or back.
Zercher: size lift for quads and upper back. Bag in the crooks of your elbows, stay tall. Wear sleeves or a towel; if the elbows complain, do SB Bear Hug Squat 8 at the same load instead.
TEST: one strict max set, dead hang to chin over rings, 2s down, no kip. Log your real number, even if it's more or less than 8. 10+ reps pain-free means weighted pull-ups can come back next block.
Lats without bending the elbows. No more pull-ups today.
Supported row: one hand braced on a box or bench so the lower back rests before leg day. Pause 1s at the top. Floor press keeps chest volume up. 24+20: switch hands each set.
Rear delts, side delts, triceps: the shoulder caps and arm size.
Load stays at 130lbs; progress time. Hug it high and tight, upper back working hard.

Clean to the rack once, then run each rung straight through. Box squat: sit, pause 1s. The last dead clean stays racked for the lunges (alternate legs). Swap bells in the rest; 24+20: switch hands each heavy rung.
Hard, snappy swings for hamstrings and glutes to balance all that squatting; snatches keep your EMOM engine and lockout.
